description: TheSportsDB team search: up to 5 teams matching a name, with sport, league, formed year, stadium, country, website and English description. Community-maintained database; uses TheSportsDB's public test key unless the owner sets THESPORTSDB_KEY. Related tools on this server, for a different need: dev_sherdog when you need Sherdog MMA fighter profile by Sherdog fighter id: name; dev_teamrankings when you need TeamRankings team stat table for NBA or NFL, for one stat. Price: $0.002 in USDC per successful call, paid with x402 (Base, Solana or Arc); failed calls are not charged.

team.description: Team name to search for, 2 to 60 characters
